judge.rationale: The candidate produces an identical production code change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` by moving `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. The unit test added to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` is nearly character-for-character identical to the reference test, verifying the execution order of `beforeSession`, `onError`, and `afterSession`, as well as error propagation. The candidate also accurately updates the specification files (including line number references across specs) and documents the behavioral change and deployer assumptions in `CHANGELOG.md`. The only minor divergence is the addition of a redundant standalone acceptance test file (`chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts`) and `.lore/dod.md`, which do not detract from correctness or completeness.
